input.summary: Insert a short insurance covenant in Miscellaneous
input.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement has no insurance covenant; as Commerce One hosts the MarketSite.net Service and its personnel work alongside ours, we ask for standard E&O and cyber cover with certificates on request (numbering to follow on renumbering of Section 14).

ops.text: 14.11 Insurance. Commerce One shall maintain, at its own expense, throughout the term of this Agreement and for one (1) year thereafter: commercial general liability insurance of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate; professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000; and, where Commerce One processes Corio or Customer data, cyber liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000. Commerce One shall provide certificates of insurance to Corio on request.

input.summary: Add transition assistance and data return on expiry or termination
input.comment: [Playbook] Section 11.3 addresses Confidential Information but not our exit: we need transition assistance and the return of Corio and Customer data held in the MarketSite.net Service in a machine-readable format, with certified deletion thereafter.

ops.text: 11.4 Transition Assistance and Data Return. Upon expiry or termination of this Agreement for any reason, Commerce One shall (a) at Corio's request, provide reasonable transition assistance for up to six (6) months at Commerce One's then-current rates; (b) within thirty (30) days of Corio's request, return to Corio all Corio and Customer data in its possession in a commonly used, machine-readable format; and (c) thereafter delete such data from its systems and certify such deletion to Corio in writing.
